links.outcome: LLM smoking variable extraction accuracy against manual annotation on local historical notes
links.effect: Generative LLMs achieved >96% accuracy across seven smoking variables versus manually annotated Stanford and Sutter notes.
links.quote: Generative LLMs achieved superior performance ( > 96% accuracy) across seven smoking variables, with external validation showing robust generalizability (97.5-98.8% accuracy).

links.outcome: LLM extraction accuracy on external validation at a second health system
links.effect: External validation showed 97.5-98.8% accuracy across sites, indicating robust generalizability.
links.quote: Generative LLMs achieved superior performance ( > 96% accuracy) across seven smoking variables, with external validation showing robust generalizability (97.5-98.8% accuracy).

unlisted_practices: Rule-based longitudinal smoothing applied to LLM outputs to improve data quality
Using LLM-extracted smoking history in risk models for lung cancer second malignancy surveillance versus NCCN guidelines

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs and NLP extraction pipeline retrospectively on EHR notes across health systems, and applies the extracted data to risk models for surveillance without testing a health system deployment practice or guardrail.
